The food on it is scrambled eggs (or possibly a potato mash) in a pile about 160 px (12 cm) wide, plus 3 or 4 roasted potato pieces and a small piece at the top.

The egg pile is roughly 12 x 8 cm and about 2 cm thick. That is about 100-120 g of eggs, at around 1.6 kcal/g, so roughly 170 kcal. The roasted potato pieces come to about 4 pieces x 20 g = 80 g, at about 1.5 kcal/g, so roughly 120 kcal. The small piece at the top adds about 10 g.

Total weight is about 200 g, and total energy is about 300 kcal.
